name: site-footer
description: Marketing footer: brand + tagline column, link columns and a legal bar; router-agnostic via linkComponent.
designIntent: Footers are copied between projects with inconsistent link handling. SiteFooter provides the standard multi-column layout, safe external links and a legal row.
